item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"sequence_modeling","rationale":"Reduce the causal context cap to max(1, ceil(0.75 × current_length)) for all four datasets, retaining recent interactions chronologically. Existing metadata propagates the reduced cap to the generated predictor. GRU topology, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"MAXLEN        = int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\"))","replace":"MAXLEN        = max(1, (3 * int(os.environ.get(\"GRU4REC_MAXLEN\", \"128\")) + 3) // 4)"}]}],"change_summary":"Reduce default context from 128 to 96 consistently across training, validation and prediction."}
